newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gives priority to sale of telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gives priority to sale of telecom stake.

text.p: Pakistan's caretaker government said on Monday it had put the sale of a 26 percent stake in the state-run Pakistan Telecommunication Company Ltd (PTCL) high on its privatisation agenda.
"The privatisation of PTCL is the leading transaction which we have been trying to do for more than a year," state Privatisation Commission chairman Salman Shah told a news conference.

"The government has shown its commitment in trying to improve the systems and processes within PTCL, move the process of its privatisation right upfront and tackle the issues that have been raised by the international investors," he said.
Shah said the commission had held discussions with many strategic investors but the process had moved slowly.
The government has decided to give priority to the PTCL privatisation and prepare the company for sale by improving its management, appointing a new chairman from the private sector, Nasim Mirza.
